name: 模版包管理 - 筛选专项(4筛选+重置)
description: 覆盖模版包管理全部筛选功能：店铺名称/店铺ID/买手名称(fill react:true)+使用状态(AntD Select mouse.click)+重置按钮清空验证+每个筛选后卡片数量对比。

steps.description: 等待店铺卡片列表加载

steps.expression: (() => { const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input[placeholder], input.ant-input'); const selects = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select'); const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-card, [class*=card]'); const btns = document.querySelectorAll('button, .ant-btn'); return { inputCount: inputs.length, inputs: Array.from(inputs).map(i=>({placeholder:i.placeholder})), selectCount: selects.length, initialCardCount: cards.length, hasReset: Array.from(btns).some(b=>/重置/.test(b.textContent)) }; })()
steps.description: 探查筛选组件和初始卡片数量
开始网络抓包-监控筛选API

steps.expression: (() => { const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-card, [class*=card]'); return { countAfterShopFilter: cards.length }; })()
steps.description: 统计店铺名称筛选后卡片数量

steps.expression: (() => { const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input[placeholder]'); const hasValue = Array.from(inputs).some(i => i.value && i.value.trim()); return { cleared: !hasValue }; })()
(() => { const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-card, [class*=card]'); return { countAfterIdFilter: cards.length }; })()
steps.description: 统计店铺ID筛选后卡片数量

steps.expression: (() => { const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-card, [class*=card]'); return { countAfterBuyerFilter: cards.length }; })()
steps.description: 统计买手名称筛选后卡片数量
获取使用状态选项列表

steps.expression: (() => { const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-card, [class*=card]'); const statusTags = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-tag, [class*=tag]'); const inUseCards = Array.from(cards).filter(c => /使用中/.test(c.textContent)); return { countAfterStatusFilter: cards.length, inUseCardCount: inUseCards.length, statusTags: Array.from(statusTags).map(t=>t.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,5) }; })()
steps.description: 验证使用状态筛选效果: 卡片数+使用中卡片数

steps.expression: (() => { const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input[placeholder]'); const selects = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-selection-item'); const hasValue = Array.from(inputs).some(i => i.value && i.value.trim()); return { allCleared: !hasValue, selectCleared: selects.length === 0 || Array.from(selects).every(s => /全部|请选择|placeholder/.test(s.textContent)) }; })()
steps.description: 最终验证重置: 所有Input清空+Select恢复默认

realDomNotes: 模版包管理筛选专项: ①店铺名称(fill react:true) ②店铺ID(fill react:true) ③买手名称(fill react:true) ④使用状态(AntD Select mouse.click展开, 选项: 全部/使用中/未使用) ⑤重置按钮清空所有筛选 ⑥每次筛选后对比卡片数量验证效果。
preconditions: F88预发环境可访问，测试账号已登录，当前身份为F88，至少存在多个店铺卡片
